purpose: Rules used by AuditQuests.pas to classify QUST records from the actual game files rather than from quest names. Spec section 8 and 13.

hardExclusions.comment: A record matching any of these is never a tagging candidate, regardless of other signals.
hardExclusions.noDisplayName: QUST with an empty or missing FULL. These are controllers, dialogue holders and system quests - they never appear in the pilipboy log.
hardExclusions.runOnceFlag: DNAM\Flags has 'Run Once' set. A run-once quest cannot be re-issued.
hardExclusions.startGameEnabledWithoutStoryNode: Start Game Enabled and not referenced by any SMQN - almost always a persistent system/controller quest.

requiredPositiveSignals.comment: A record must satisfy minSignals of the following to be proposed as radiant. Weight is advisory - the audit reports each signal individually.

signals.description: The QUST is referenced by a Story Manager Quest Node (SMQN). This is the strongest available record-level evidence that the engine issues the quest procedurally rather than once by script.
signals.howChecked: ReferencedByCount / ReferencedByIndex, filtered on signature SMQN. Requires xEdit reference info to be built.

signals.description: DNAM\Flags contains 'Allow repeated stages'. Set on quests whose stages are re-run for each new issue.
signals.howChecked: String search on the flags edit value.
String search on the flags edit value.

signals.description: EditorID matches a known radiant naming family (see radiantEditorIDPatterns).
At least one quest alias is filled from a Story Manager event or by 'Find Matching Reference' rather than by a unique forced reference. Indicates rotating targets.
signals.howChecked: Alias flags inspection; advisory only, reported not enforced.

radiantEditorIDPatterns.comment: Prefix families observed in Fallout 4 plugin structure. Matching sets EDITORID_PATTERN and proposes the listed tag. Never sufficient on its own.

patterns.note: Outpost raiding family - confirm repeatability individually.
Generic fallback. Reported as a candidate only, never auto-tagged.

timedSignals.comment: Heuristics for the [Timed - Radiant] category. All results are proposed as 'likely' at best - confirm manually.
timedSignals.note: Most Minutemen settlement-threat quests fail after a fixed number of in-game days. Detection is by script property, so mods that replace those scripts may change the result.

settlementSignals.note: Settlement involvement alone never sets a radiant tag (spec 13). It only selects between the settlement tag variants once a quest already qualifies.

moduleAssignment.comment: Modules are disjoint so that FOMOD toggles never produce two plugins overriding the same QUST.

order.if: sourcePlugin == Fallout4.esm and category starts with Settlement
